failed_or_abandoned: Wall leakage modelled as an exponential background term with lambda_leak = 0.50 cm (from the 1e-4/1e-2 contour criteria): dominates every configuration inside s = 7 cm and describes low-S2 events; replaced by a reconstruction floor d_reco >= 3 cm (10 sigma at 3 mm resolution).
Single wall-MSSI depth scale: LZ's own MSSI table (5.4 t annulus / 4.7 t FV = 6.25; HE SB 5.0) implies lambda = 1.23-1.36 cm versus P033's 4.3 cm; kept both as scenarios instead of choosing one.

Cylinder FV family (B) as a candidate: its contour lies outside the reconstructed wall near the cathode (d_reco,min = 0.6 cm at s = 6), so LZ's bottom flare is required by the reconstruction offset (6.2 cm at the bottom).
